Context: 5. Leave Not Due

10. Where a Government servant, who having availed himself of Leave Not Due, returns to duty but resigns or retires from service before he has earned such leave, he shall be liable to refund the leave salary to the extent the leave has not been earned subsequently. - Rule 31 (2) (b).
